title: Deployment & Hosting — Move Beyond the Laptop
key_insight: Deployment packages code and dependencies into a repeatable runtime and exposes it through controlled infrastructure.
body:
## Move Beyond the Laptop

An app works on one developer’s machine but fails elsewhere because files, packages, and settings differ.

Deployment packages code and dependencies into a repeatable runtime and exposes it through controlled infrastructure.

Keep configuration outside code, secrets in a secret store, and health checks separate from model-quality checks.
common_mistakes: A laptop environment is automatically reproducible.
Adding web servers fixes every downstream bottleneck.
Health checks prove model answer quality.
mini_exercise: Draw “Move Beyond the Laptop” as three steps and explain each one.
real_world_usage: Deployment turns a working AI service into a repeatable, secure, scalable runtime.
explain_back_prompt: Use “Move Beyond the Laptop” to explain Deployment & Hosting plainly.
